Source/scope information: libssh2-sys 0.3.3

Vendored libssh2 static build with OpenSSL backend and zlib support. Full COPYING plus per-file notice comments retained, including OpenBSD, chacha and poly1305 material. Some upstream SPDX labels differ from their full grant text; the grant text is reproduced unchanged and ISC is conservatively included in the expression. No inference that alternate Windows/crypto backends were compiled.
